nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: KiroValidator validates and refreshes Kiro OAuth tokens, and provides platform-specific helpers to auto-detect a locally cached Kiro token/device registration from the macOS Keychain or Kiro's local SQLite database.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel declaring and re-exporting every provider validator submodule (anthropic, azure_openai, claude_code, codex, copilot, cursor, google, kiro, openai, opencode_go, quota_windows, zhipu).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: OpenAIValidator validates API keys for OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible providers (DeepSeek, Groq, xAI, etc.), listing models and sending a minimal test chat completion, with model-prefix filtering per provider.

nodes.name: opencode_go.rs
nodes.summary: OpenCodeGoQuotaFetcher scrapes usage/subscription data for opencode.ai workspaces by calling its internal server endpoints with a session cookie, parsing rolling/weekly/monthly usage percentages out of embedded page text.

nodes.name: quota_windows.rs
nodes.summary: Shared helper for building a normalized QuotaInfo from session/weekly usage windows, used by several OAuth-based providers (Claude Code, Codex, Zhipu) to avoid duplicating quota-aggregation logic.

nodes.name: KiroToken
nodes.summary: A cached Kiro OAuth token (access/refresh tokens, expiry, region, OAuth flow, scopes, client credentials) with an is_expired helper.

nodes.name: KiroValidator
nodes.summary: Validates and locally format-checks Kiro OAuth tokens.

nodes.name: DeviceRegistration
nodes.summary: OAuth device-flow client registration (client id/secret) read from Kiro's local storage.

nodes.name: ModelsResponse
nodes.summary: Deserialization target for an OpenAI-compatible provider's list-models API response.

nodes.name: ModelInfo
nodes.summary: A single model entry (id, context length) from an OpenAI-compatible models list.

nodes.name: ChatCompletionRequest
nodes.summary: Request body for a minimal OpenAI-compatible chat completion test call.

nodes.name: ChatMessage
nodes.summary: A single chat message (role + content) in an OpenAI-compatible completion request.

nodes.name: OpenAIValidator
nodes.summary: HTTP-client-backed validator shared by OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible providers (DeepSeek, Groq, xAI, etc.): lists models, applies per-provider model-prefix filtering, and sends a minimal test completion.

nodes.name: OpenCodeGoQuotaFetcher
nodes.summary: HTTP-client-backed fetcher that resolves an opencode.ai workspace id and scrapes rolling/weekly/monthly subscription usage from the workspace page's embedded page text using a session cookie.

nodes.name: ParsedSubscription
nodes.summary: Parsed usage percentages and reset countdowns (rolling, weekly, monthly) extracted from an opencode.ai workspace page.

nodes.name: QuotaWindow
nodes.summary: A single named usage window (session or weekly) with a used-percent figure and reset time, with constructors for the two common window types.

nodes.name: is_expired
nodes.summary: Checks whether a KiroToken's access token has passed its expiry timestamp.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a KiroValidator with the default timeout.

nodes.name: with_timeout
nodes.summary: Constructs a KiroValidator with a custom timeout.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Validates a Kiro OAuth token JSON payload, checking expiry and required fields.

nodes.name: validate_format
nodes.summary: Checks that a Kiro token JSON payload is well-formed and parseable, without checking expiry.

nodes.name: get_kiro_models
nodes.summary: Returns the static list of models available under a Kiro subscription.

nodes.name: get_kiro_sqlite_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the platform-specific path to Kiro's local SQLite database where cached tokens/device registration are stored.

nodes.name: read_token_from_macos_keychain
nodes.summary: Reads a cached Kiro OAuth token from the macOS Keychain via the `security` CLI (macOS only; a no-op stub is compiled in on other platforms).

nodes.name: read_token_from_sqlite
nodes.summary: Reads a cached Kiro OAuth token from Kiro's local SQLite database.

nodes.name: read_device_reg_from_sqlite
nodes.summary: Reads the OAuth device-flow client registration from Kiro's local SQLite database.

nodes.name: read_device_reg_from_macos_keychain
nodes.summary: Reads the OAuth device-flow client registration from the macOS Keychain.

nodes.name: get_device_registration
nodes.summary: Resolves Kiro's device registration by trying the Keychain (on macOS) and falling back to SQLite.

nodes.name: get_local_kiro_token
nodes.summary: Resolves a locally cached Kiro token by trying the Keychain (on macOS) and falling back to SQLite.

nodes.name: detect_kiro_tokens
nodes.summary: Auto-detects a Kiro token and its associated device registration from local machine state, for the auto-detect key flow.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an OpenAIValidator with the default timeout.

nodes.name: with_timeout
nodes.summary: Constructs an OpenAIValidator with a custom timeout.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Validates an OpenAI-compatible API key by listing models (filtered by provider) and sending a minimal test completion.

nodes.name: get_models
nodes.summary: Fetches the list of available models from an OpenAI-compatible provider's models API, filtering by the provider's model prefixes.

nodes.name: test_completion
nodes.summary: Sends a minimal chat completion request to confirm the API key can perform inference.

nodes.name: validate_format
nodes.summary: Checks that an OpenAI-compatible API key string is well-formed, without a network call.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an OpenCodeGoQuotaFetcher with the default timeout.

nodes.name: fetch_quota
nodes.summary: Resolves the workspace id for a session cookie (or uses an override) and fetches that workspace's usage quota from opencode.ai.

nodes.name: resolve_workspace_ids
nodes.summary: Determines the candidate opencode.ai workspace ids to query for a given session cookie, using an override if provided or discovering them from the server.

nodes.name: fetch_workspace_quota
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses the subscription usage page for a specific opencode.ai workspace id.

nodes.name: workspace_id_override_from_key
nodes.summary: Extracts a workspace id override embedded in a stored key's metadata, if present.

nodes.name: normalize_cookie_input
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw cookie string into the form expected by the opencode.ai session cookie header.

nodes.name: filter_auth_cookie
nodes.summary: Strips a raw cookie header down to just the auth cookie needed for the request.

nodes.name: valid_workspace_id
nodes.summary: Validates that a string looks like a well-formed opencode.ai workspace id.

nodes.name: parse_workspace_ids
nodes.summary: Extracts candidate workspace ids embedded in the opencode.ai server response text.

nodes.name: parse_subscription_from_page_text
nodes.summary: Extracts and parses the embedded subscription/usage JSON block from an opencode.ai workspace page's HTML/JS text.

nodes.name: extract_usage_block
nodes.summary: Locates the raw text span of the usage data object embedded in a workspace page for a given key.

nodes.name: balanced_object_block
nodes.summary: Extracts a balanced brace-delimited JSON object substring starting at a given opening brace, tolerating nested braces.

nodes.name: extract_top_level_number
nodes.summary: Extracts a top-level numeric field's value from a raw (not fully parsed) JSON object text block.

nodes.name: parse_number_prefix
nodes.summary: Parses the leading numeric prefix of a text fragment into a float.

nodes.name: subscription_to_quota
nodes.summary: Converts a ParsedSubscription's rolling/weekly/monthly usage figures into a normalized QuotaInfo.

nodes.name: usage_item
nodes.summary: Builds a single UsageItem from a usage type and used-percent figure.

nodes.name: session
nodes.summary: Constructs a QuotaWindow tagged as the session (short) usage window.

nodes.name: weekly
nodes.summary: Constructs a QuotaWindow tagged as the weekly usage window.

nodes.name: unix_seconds_to_rfc3339
nodes.summary: Converts a Unix timestamp in seconds to an RFC3339 datetime string.

nodes.name: normalize_reset_time
nodes.summary: Normalizes a provider-supplied reset-time value (Unix seconds or ISO string) into a consistent RFC3339 string.

nodes.name: quota_from_windows
nodes.summary: Shared helper that builds a normalized QuotaInfo (remaining percentage, usage items, reset windows) from a plan type, quota source, and a list of QuotaWindows.
